entities.name: Extended emergency number list
entities.description: An information element that contains a list of emergency numbers with URN information, indicating numbers valid within the same country as the PLMN or valid only in the specific PLMN/SNPN from which it is received.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the extended emergency number list information element to the UE.

entities.name: Emergency numbers
entities.description: The list of emergency numbers with URN information contained within the extended emergency number list IE.

entities.name: PLMN scope
entities.description: Condition specifying that emergency numbers are valid within the same country as the PLMN from which the IE is received.

entities.name: SNPN scope
entities.description: Condition specifying that emergency numbers are valid only in the specific PLMN or SNPN from which the IE is received.

relations.description: The network may send the extended emergency number list IE to the UE.
The extended emergency number list IE contains a list of emergency numbers with URN information.
The contents of the IE indicate emergency numbers valid within the same country as the PLMN from which it is received.
The contents of the IE indicate emergency numbers valid only in the specific PLMN or SNPN from which it is received.
